title: Studio Bright Green’s quietly confident identity for Levrant — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: London-based Studio Bright Green has created the identity for Levrant, a UK practice that works on historic buildings across architecture, heritage consultancy and townscape. Research with the practice’s team and its clients led to a name change and a visual language built around quiet confidence. That confidence runs through everything, from the typography and colour to the photography and the materials the team works with every day.

title: Ashfall Studio extends Carnilove’s pet food identity into a system — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Carnilove is a premium pet-food brand that is sold in more than 80 markets, with an identity that Design Bridge and Partners created around the tension between the domestic pet and its wilder instincts. Prague-based design and technology partner Ashfall Studio came on board to take that identity further, spending 18 months developing it into a system for Carnilove’s teams to use across all of those markets.

title: How New Apology branded ET AL for creators without factory contact — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: ET AL produces apparel for creative people, young clothing brands and small teams, taking on sourcing, sampling, production and delivery, as well as inventory and reorders after launch. Its customers have had to choose between print-on-demand, which is easy but generic, and traditional production, with its high minimums and months spent chasing factories. title: Twice Shy positions Tula Louise as a soap atelier through a rebrand — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Tula Louise is a soap brand that Jowanda Daley-Thomas started during COVID, when she began experimenting with natural pigments. Independent branding studio Twice Shy was commissioned to rework the brand as it stood, from strategy and positioning to the identity, logo, art direction and packaging design.

title: A sub-45-minute 10K gave Tinloof the concept for Enroute’s identity — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Enroute is a running/cycling store and community based in Vancouver that had gone for years without a clearly defined identity. With plans to grow beyond Canada, new retail stores and its first mobile app ahead, Enroute commissioned design and development agency Tinloof to create its first proper brand strategy, visual and motion identity, online store and app design. title: How&How brand “future of zero carbon concrete” Biozeroc with engaging architectural forms — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: The concrete industry is one of the biggest producers of carbon dioxide in the world (producing between 4-8% of total global CO2 emissions), second only to water. Because of this, reducing cement-related carbon emissions deserves to be brought to the front of the climate conversation. Thankfully, UK startup Biozeroc is putting in the work, and their team of scientists and engineers are developing a zero-carbon alternative as the first priority – with other materials to follow in the future.
